-- fs --
home/evan/readme.md
home/evan/projects/gloss/main.go
home/evan/projects/tiny/a.txt
etc/hosts
etc/ssh/config
-- script --
start /home/evan/projects
size 60 10
note an absolute path lists that folder without going there
type /etc/
state viewdir /etc
state dir /home/evan/projects
snapshot etc
note Enter on a typed folder goes to it
press enter
state dir /etc
state filter ""
note home, and parent
type ~/
state viewdir /home/evan
press ctrl+u
type ../
state viewdir /
note a file typed in a path is chosen with Enter once the cursor is on it
press ctrl+u
type /etc/ho
press enter
state chosen /etc/hosts
